name: edusphere-enterprise
description: EduSphere Enterprise — Full-stack monorepo. Frontend + Backend microservices.

scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently --kill-others "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.dev:backend: concurrently "npm run start:auth" "npm run start:user" "npm run start:course" "npm run start:attendance" "npm run start:admin" "npm run start:analytics" "npm run start:assessment" "npm run start:assignment" "npm run start:calendar" "npm run start:certificate" "npm run start:discussion" "npm run start:library" "npm run start:notification" "npm run start:placement" "npm run start:timetable"
scripts.lan:up: dotenv -e infra/.env.lan -- docker compose -f infra/compose.lan.yml up --build -d
scripts.lan:down: dotenv -e infra/.env.lan -- docker compose -f infra/compose.lan.yml down
scripts.lan:status: dotenv -e infra/.env.lan -- docker compose -f infra/compose.lan.yml ps
scripts.lan:logs: dotenv -e infra/.env.lan -- docker compose -f infra/compose.lan.yml logs -f
